indication_area: Hypoparathyroidism (adjunct to calcium and vitamin D to control hypocalcemia)
geography: Worldwide (Shire: NATPARA, later NATPARA/NATPAR line; Takeda: NATPARA/NATPAR line)
formulation: powder and solvent for solution for injection (multiple-dose cartridge)
moa: Recombinant parathyroid hormone (PTH 1-84) replacement; PTH1 receptor agonist

approval_evidence.quote: application_number BLA125511, brand_name NATPARA, submission_type ORIG, submission_status AP, submission_status_date 20150123 (openFDA Drugs@FDA record)

launch_evidence.quote: Shire made NATPARA available on April 1, 2015, after acquiring the product through its acquisition of NPS Pharma. In the second quarter of 2015 sales of $6 million were recorded. (Shire plc Form 10-Q for Q2 2015, filed 2015-07-30)

series_start_reason: Series starts at the launch quarter (NATPARA made available April 1, 2015; the Q1 2015 Shire release prints no NATPARA row).
series_end_reason: Takeda's last NATPARA/NATPAR line is in the Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2022 (FY2021, 5,353 JPY millions; filed 2022-06-29). The FY2022 quarterly securities reports (Form 6-K filed 2022-08-04, 2022-11-04, 2023-02-07) print no NATPARA row (brand not mentioned in the 2022-08-04 report), and the FY2022 20-F revenue-by-product table (filed 2023-06-28) carries no NATPARA line, so the last quarter with an own line is fiscal Q4 FY2021 = 2022Q1.
notes: Shire rows USD millions (Shire plc, CIK 936402; 2018Q4 from Shire's Full Year 2018 Results furnished by Takeda on Form 6-K 2019-02-15). Takeda rows JPY millions (CIK 1395064); the 2019Q1 Takeda figure covers January 8 - March 31, 2019. The sharp fall from 2019Q4 coincides with the U.S. recall of NATPARA (not quantified here).
search_log: Listed every Shire plc (CIK 936402) and Takeda (CIK 1395064) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions; scanned every Shire 8-K with item 2.02 filed 2007-04 to 2018-12 for 'VYVANSE|NATPARA' table rows (shire_8k.txt); Takeda earnings-material 6-K/20-F documents (FY2018 Q4 summary through FY2026 Q1) read for NATPARA rows (bin/tkrows.py); brand-hit counts over every Takeda 6-K/20-F document in Jan/Feb/Apr/May/Jul/Aug/Oct/Nov 2018-12 to 2026-10 (bin/tkscan.py, tk_hits.json).

Takeda FY2019: no NATPARA figure in the Q1 report; H1/Q3 reports print only year-to-date figures (12.4, 13.0 Bn JPY); quarters are the prior-year three-month columns of the FY2020 reports (7,868; 4,515; 622), which agree with the year-to-date figures (7,868 + 4,515 = 12,383; + 622 = 13,005); FY2019 Q4 = 13,635 - 13,005 = 630; FY2019 sums to 13,635.
No NATPARA row in any Takeda quarterly report from FY2022 Q1 or in the FY2022+ 20-F revenue-by-product tables; series ends 2022Q1 (see series_end_reason).

reviewed_anomalies.2019Q1: Reporting currency changes here from Shire's USD to Takeda's JPY; gold normalizes both to USD. Checked at source and kept as printed.
